description:
**Role:** LeadTalent Acquisition

**Department:** Human Resources

**Location:** Bengaluru

**Reporting To:** Manager – Human Resources

**About Remidio**

Remidio is a global pioneer in AI-driven eye care, transforming healthcare through innovative ophthalmic equipment and AI-powered diagnostic solutions. As India's first company to secure CDSCO approval for adaptive ophthalmic AI and CE marking under EU-MDR, Remidio is at the forefront of early disease detection, including diabetic retinopathy, glaucoma and AMD, with ambitions to address systemic conditions such as CVD and CKD.

Our FDA-registered devices have screened over 16 million patients across 40+ countries. Founded 16 years ago with a vision to democratize preventive healthcare, Remidio combines technology and innovation to make quality healthcare accessible worldwide.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a **Lead – Talent Acquisition** who can operate as a strategic talent acquisition partner to the business while remaining deeply involved in hiring execution.

The role will work closely with business leaders to understand current and future talent requirements, translate business priorities into effective hiring strategies, identify critical talent pools and drive hiring across specialised and leadership positions.

The ideal candidate will bring strong business acumen, talent market understanding and the ability to navigate niche hiring markets, particularly within the medical device, ophthalmology, healthcare technology or MedTech industry.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Partnering & Talent Strategy**

* + Partner with business leaders and functional heads to understand business priorities, organisational requirements and talent needs.
  + Translate workforce requirements into focused talent acquisition plans aligned with business growth and expansion objectives.
  + Advise hiring managers on talent availability, market intelligence, compensation benchmarks and realistic hiring timelines.
  + Drive manpower planning discussions and proactively identify upcoming and critical talent requirements.
  + Challenge and refine hiring requirements to ensure alignment between role expectations, market availability and business needs.

**Strategic & Niche Talent Acquisition**

* + Own end-to-end recruitment across business-critical, technical, commercial, engineering, product and leadership positions.
  + Drive specialised hiring across ophthalmology, medical devices, MedTech, healthcare technology and related industries.
  + Develop targeted talent mapping and market intelligence strategies to identify high-quality and passive talent.
  + Build sustainable talent pipelines for critical roles, emerging business requirements and future leadership needs.
  + Leverage industry networks, competitor mapping, talent intelligence and direct headhunting to access niche talent pools.
  + Independently drive candidate evaluation, stakeholder alignment, compensation discussions and offer closures.

**Hiring Delivery & Stakeholder Management**

* + Own hiring outcomes against agreed recruitment priorities, quality expectations and turnaround timelines.
  + Work closely with hiring managers throughout the selection process to ensure timely feedback, effective decision-making and closure.
  + Drive offer strategy, candidate engagement, pre-joining connect and offer-to-joining conversion.
  + Manage recruitment partners and consultants, ensuring delivery quality and cost effectiveness.
  + Monitor hiring effectiveness through metrics such as Time-to-Hire, Time-to-Fill, offer acceptance, source effectiveness and quality of hire.

**Talent Acquisition Excellence**

* + Drive continuous improvement in recruitment processes, sourcing strategies and candidate experience.
  + Leverage recruitment analytics and dashboards to identify hiring trends, bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.
  + Maintain recruitment governance, ATS hygiene and hiring documentation through Keka Hire.
  + Strengthen employer branding, talent outreach, referral programmes and campus engagement initiatives.

**Qualification & Experience**

* + Bachelor's or master’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, Psychology or a related discipline.
  + 4 - 6 years of progressive experience in Talent Acquisition, preferably in a business-facing TA role.
  + Experience in medical devices, ophthalmology, MedTech, healthcare technology or medical equipment is strongly preferred.
  + Demonstrated experience in managing niche, leadership, technical and commercial hiring mandates.
  + Experience partnering directly with business heads, functional leaders and senior stakeholders.

**Core Competencies**

* + Strong business acumen and the ability to connect talent acquisition priorities with business objectives.
  + Strategic talent mapping, market intelligence and headhunting capabilities.
  + Strong understanding of specialised talent markets, particularly medical devices and healthcare.
  + Ability to influence hiring managers and provide data-backed talent market insights.
  + Strong stakeholder management, negotiation and decision-making skills.
  + Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret recruitment metrics and drive hiring effectiveness.
  + High ownership, execution orientation and ability to independently manage multiple critical mandates.
  + Proficiency in LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, Keka Hire and MS Excel.

description:
### **ABOUT EARNIN**

As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for people living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks. We're fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We're growing fast and excited to bring on world-class talent to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.

EarnIn is becoming an AI-native company, embedding AI agents into how we build, analyze, and operate across every function. Teams use AI Agents to move from ideas to execution faster. By letting agents handle repetitive tasks, our people can focus on judgment, creativity, and hard problems. We pair this experimentation with the strict review and security guardrails our regulated financial environment requires, always keeping a focus on privacy and the people who rely on our products.

As a company, we are becoming AI-native, and we encourage you to use AI tools throughout much of your interview process. If you use AI during the live interview, just say so; a quick, natural mention of how it helped and why you are using it is all we need. What we're evaluating is your judgment, reasoning, and ability to own and defend your work, not whether AI was involved. Some rounds, particularly those focused on your career history and past experiences, will not allow the use of AI, and we'll let you know of those in advance. When in doubt, ask your recruiter or interviewer directly.

**POSITION SUMMARY**  
We're on a mission to reinvent the financial system and make it work for people. We are looking for an experienced professional to lead a full-stack engineering team comprising backend and mobile engineers. As a hands-on Tech Lead Manager for one of our core services teams, you will have the unique opportunity to contribute to the design and development of some of our early-stage, innovative products. You will work with your cross-functional partners and team to shape the direction of these products and help make them significant drivers for the company.

This position is a hybrid role based in our **Bengaluru office,** with 2 days a week in the office as part of our expanding site. EarnIn provides excellent benefits, including healthcare, internet/cell phone reimbursement, a learning and development stipend, and potential opportunities to travel to our Mountain View HQ. Our salary ranges depend on role, level, and location.

* Partner closely with Product and other engineering teams to improve business metrics and build new features. Examples include improving user acquisition metrics, cross-selling and upselling products, and improving user experience.
* Drive the design and implementation of new product areas and features. Break complex problems down to their bare essentials, translate that complexity into elegant design, and create high-quality, maintainable code.
* Guide your team through ambiguity and ensure technical excellence through rapid experimentation cycles.
* Guide your team to strong execution—make pragmatic decisions, help them launch MVPs quickly, and iterate based on feedback.
* Lead your team through frequent pivots and evolving priorities in a fast-changing environment.
* Recruit other great engineers for your team and support recruiting efforts across teams.
* Mentor and coach the engineers on your team. Help them advance their careers by enabling them to do the best work of their lives.
* Manage cross-functional relationships with all teams to deliver high-quality products.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent industry experience
* 7+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years leading a small team as a manager.
* You're just as energized diving into architecture, writing clean, scalable code, and solving challenging technical problems as you are mentoring engineers, shaping team culture, and driving delivery. You know when to roll up your sleeves and when to empower others—and you're equally excited to do both.
* You can work comfortably with a cross-functional team of PMs, Analysts, and mobile and back-end-focused engineers.
* You have led a team that consistently delivered high-quality output on critical infrastructure projects.
* You are a creative, tenacious problem solver with a get-it-done attitude
* You tend to be the standard bearer who takes a great deal of pride in your work and can inspire others to rise to the occasion
* You can create and maintain a positive, healthy team environment in which everyone is supported, encouraged, and meaningfully challenged to do great work
* Preferred tech skills: C#, .NET/.NET Core, Kotlin, Python, SQL, Databricks, AWS, REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, Kafka, CI/CD, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native development.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, or similar tools) as part of your software development workflow
* Experience in fintech is a plus.
* Experience leading the design, implementation, and deployment of high-scale cross-functional payments systems.

#LI-Hybrid

At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. Our team is diverse not only in background and experience but also in perspective. We celebrate our diversity and strive to create a culture of belonging. Working in Science at Uber means solving complex, real-world problems that don't always have a textbook solution. You will be part of a team that turns massive amounts of data into actionable insights, influencing everything from marketplace efficiency to user experience. In this role, you’ll be a technical "detective," unpicking data-driven puzzles in a high-stakes, fast-moving environment. You’ll thrive here if you stay calm under pressure, embrace the "messy" reality of imperfect datasets, and have the grit to move projects from hypothesis to production.  
  
This is a role for an owner who is energized by the challenge of building at scale. You will navigate the ambiguity of shifting priorities and internal complexity, ensuring that our data-driven products are robust, reliable, and grounded in sound statistical principles. If you're sharp, steady, and motivated by meaningful impact at global scale this is where you’ll grow.  
  
**What you’ll do**  
  

* **Develop data-driven insights** and collaborate with cross-functional partners: Product, Engineering, and Operations to identify opportunities and prioritize optimization initiatives.
* **Build statistical and machine learning models** to provide strategic insights and real-time production enhancements to global products.
* **Design and analyze experiments** using A/B testing and causal inference, presenting results that provide actionable recommendations for product growth.
* **Drive technical excellence** by creating logging, metrics, and diagnostic tools that orient our teams around data-driven product development.
* **Define success metrics** in close partnership with stakeholders to ensure our teams are measuring impact accurately and consistently.

* If M.S. degree, a minimum of 2+ years of industry experience required; if B.S. degree, a minimum of 3+ years of industry experience required.
* Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python or R) for statistical analysis and algorithm prototyping.

**Preferred Qualifications**  
  

* **Exceptional Communication Skills:** A track record of conveying complex technical findings in a manner that is easy for marketers and non-technical partners to understand.

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.

description:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**

Gracenote, a Nielsen company, is dedicated to connecting audiences to the entertainment they love, powering a better media future for all people. We are the content data business unit of Nielsen that powers innovative entertainment experiences for the world's leading media companies. Our entertainment metadata and connected IDs deliver advanced content navigation and discovery to connect consumers to the content they love and discover new ones.

Every day, Gracenote ingests data for over 100,000 channels and hundreds of streaming catalogs worldwide. It arrives through thousands of partner feeds covering linear schedules, streaming and VOD catalogs, and program metadata, in every format imaginable and changing constantly. That data powers entertainment discovery for the world's top cable, OTT, CE and digital clients, reaching hundreds of millions of consumers.

We are hiring a Sr. Product Manager II to own the Single Ingest Platform, the system that gets all of this data into Gracenote. Based in our Bengaluru engineering center, you will report to our Director of Product Management, Data Ingest and Delivery, and work alongside our Data Delivery Product Manager. Together you own how data enters and leaves our AI-driven metadata factory.

This is a software platform role, and the platform is a service. Teams downstream decide what to do with the data once it lands. Your job is to make sure every source is set up fast, every field we need is captured correctly, and every change reaches the platform in minutes. Speed and accuracy at scale are the whole game.

It is also a hands-on role. You will write specs yourself, work directly with engineers and Data Architects, and query the data to answer your own questions. We are looking for someone senior who still genuinely enjoys this work, and who sees AI as the way to run thousands of feeds without thousands of manual fixes.

Responsibilities

* Own the product vision, roadmap and delivery for the Single Ingest Platform across linear schedules, streaming and VOD catalogs, and every other source type our datasets depend on.
* Own the speed and accuracy of getting partner data into Gracenote, from onboarding new sources to processing every update.
* Drive AI innovation so ingest scales to new sources, markets and metadata types with greater speed and efficiency, without adding manual processes.
* Ensure the platform is monitored for performance and breaks, so issues are caught and resolved before they affect downstream teams.
* Run ingest as a service, translating the needs of Dataset Product Managers, metadata factory teams and Delivery into a prioritized roadmap.
* Define and publish the platform's service levels and key metrics for speed, accuracy, reliability and cost, and use them to drive decisions.
* Work effectively across a globally distributed organization, with strong async written communication, disciplined documentation, and willingness to flex hours for overlap with US and EU stakeholders.

 **Qualifications**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years on platform, data or data integration products.
* Hands-on experience with data ingestion or integration at scale: onboarding external sources, handling format and schema changes, and monitoring data flows.
* Has applied AI or ML inside a product, not only for personal productivity. Examples include extraction, classification, anomaly detection or schema mapping. Can reason about confidence, error rates and when a human needs to step in.
* Actively uses LLMs in day-to-day product work to speed up analysis, automate repetitive PM tasks and make better decisions. Be prepared to walk through concrete examples in the interview.
* Demonstrated appetite for hands-on IC work at a senior level. Comfortable with XML, JSON, SQL and REST APIs, and able to write or LLM-assist your own Python or SQL scripts to answer product questions.
* Runs a product on a small set of input and output metrics, and delivers predictably against commitments in a structured, milestone-driven development process.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with a proven ability to influence stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience with TV and entertainment metadata, EPG data or content supply chains.
* Familiarity with industry metadata and feed standards such as CableLabs ADI, TV-Anytime, or MovieLabs MEC and Avails.
* Experience with near-real-time or event-driven data pipelines.
* Experience building partner-facing source specifications or self-service onboarding tools.
* Experience partnering with Data Architects to shape complex business data into coherent, extensible, scalable structures.

 **Additional Information**

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Hardware Project Manager
description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

Plans, prepares and coordinates tecchnical projects according to the Project Management (PM) standards defined, throughout all stages of the Q-gate process.

**Business Title: Hardware Project Manager (North)**

**Location: Gurugram**

**POSITION SUMMARY and CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**

  

* Plan, coordinate and supervise site preparations and advise customers and contractors for the installation of SHS products, to ensure efficient and timely execution of installations according to technical and safety regulations and maximize customer satisfaction. Monitors project completion from initiation through delivery to meet revenue and cost projections.

**MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Coordinate and supervise site preparations with customers, to ensure sites are contractually compliant for SHS products installations

* Provide coordination services by planning SHS activities and resources for installation of SHS products on prepared customer sites, to ensure installations can be carried out from start to end according to plans established and contracts agreed with customers

* Collect documents of Acceptance Test results, to ensure that all contractual conditions are met according to schedule for final handover of the installation project to the customers

* Establish and manage work programs for installation and upgrades of SHS products for all parties involved (SHS departments and 3rd party sub-contractors), in order to ensure that installations are completed according to specifications and schedule and that customers can sign the Acceptance Letters

* Interface externally with customers / 3rd party vendors / architects for the timely execution of projects to ensure that they can perform their work according to established installation project plans and that necessary actions are taken to resolve issues and problems

* Coordinate external contractors’ activities on installation sites (architects, rigging companies etc…), to ensure that they can perform their work according to established installation project plans and that necessary actions are taken to resolve issues and problems

* Record all information resulting from installation meetings and site inspections with customers, SHS installation engineers and external contractors, to provide all parties the necessary information to enable them to perform their activities according to established installation project plans

* Maintain tools such as MS project/taskray , SAP, Gantt charts, trip reports, check lists and escalation reports to ensure coordination work is correctly reported

* Interface internally with Installation Supervisors / sales organization / order processing / centralized services to provide them the necessary technical support on installations and optimize customer relations

* Develop and maintain close working relationships between SHS sales, order processing, installation teams and European local and regional service managers, to achieve a smooth processing of customer orders according to installation plans and provide regular reports on ongoing installation projects

* Monitor status of installation projects to provide feedback into the forecasting process

* Monitor installation process indicators and conduct debriefings, in order to track issues and take corrective actions to solve problems and ensure installations are carried out according to established installation project plans

* Perform other duties as assigned

**EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE:**

Educational requirements: Graduate from University in Civil / Structural / Mechanical / Electrical / Electronic engineering.

Number of years related experience: Minimum 5 years of project management in healthcare or in a capital equipment field.

Number of years SHS experience: Preferred

**KNOWLEDGE**

Project Management: Sound knowledge and professional experience of project management (planning and execution), particularly as it relates to working across functional interfaces in a capital equipment field

Information Technology: Knowledge of and professional experience with microcomputers / PC based systems

Customers: Thorough understanding of customers and their requirements

Contract Negotiations: Sound understanding and application of contract terms

Business Procedures: Thorough understanding and application of SHS business procedures

Business Strategy: Knowledge of SHS strategy and sound understanding of business goals, i.e. corporate strategy, product and market strategies

Technical expertise: Knowledge of processes and methods used in SHS product areas such as product specification, product developments / expansion.

**Who we are**: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

**How we work**: When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

To find out more about Healthineers’ specific businesses, please visit our company page here.

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile where you can upload your CV. These scammers may attempt to collect your confidential personal or financial information. If you are concerned that an offer of employment with Siemens Healthineers might be a scam or that the recruiter is not legitimate, please verify by searching for the posting on the Siemens Healthineers career site.

title: Configuration Sr Analyst
description:
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Configuration Sr Analyst to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
ROLE OVERVIEW
  
  
We are seeking a skilled Application Packager to join NTT DATA's India EPM delivery team. This mid-senior role involves independently managing complex packaging projects — handling difficult repackages, compatibility remediation, scripted deployments, and advanced Intune/SCCM integration — for large global enterprise clients. The packager will serve as a key technical contributor on the India packaging team, handling L2/L3 packaging requests, driving quality standards, and contributing to platform and tooling improvements.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
Advanced Application Packaging
  

* Handle complex application repackaging scenarios including multi-component installers, 32/64-bit dual packages, per-user vs per-machine conflicts, and custom action remediation.
* Develop and maintain MSI packages from source using WiX Toolset or InstallShield IDE for applications without vendor installers.
* Apply Package Support Framework (PSF) fixups for MSIX compatibility including working directory, file redirection, and registry virtualisation fixes.
* Package and sequence App-V virtual applications including connection group configuration and dynamic composition.
* Design and implement Intune Win32 deployment strategies including staged rollouts, dependency chains, and supersedence workflows.
* Develop custom PowerShell pre-install, post-install, and detection scripts for complex packaging requirements.

Compatibility Remediation
  

* Analyse and resolve application compatibility issues including DPI awareness, UAC elevation, write virtualisation, and Windows 10/11 API compatibility.
* Apply and test compatibility shims using Microsoft Application Compatibility Toolkit (ACT) or PSF.
* Identify and remediate packaging issues causing deployment failures — custom actions, hardcoded paths, registry ACLs, and service configurations.
* Collaborate with application owners and vendors to obtain silent install parameters and resolve licensing or activation issues.
* Assess applications for MSIX packaging suitability and document conversion feasibility with recommended approach.

Deployment Integration Automation
  

* Build SCCM application models with complex detection methods, global conditions, requirement rules, and multi-deployment-type configurations.
* Develop PowerShell automation scripts for batch packaging operations, package validation, and SCCM/Intune inventory reporting.
* Integrate packaging workflows with software delivery pipelines — scripted uploads to Intune via Graph API, SCCM package import automation.
* Support Azure DevOps or CI/CD pipeline integration for automated package build and test workflows.
* Develop and maintain packaging test scripts for regression automation on golden image environments.

Quality Governance
  

* Define and enforce packaging standards, quality checklists, and peer review processes for the India packaging team.
* Conduct technical review of packages produced by junior packagers and provide structured feedback.
* Maintain and improve the packaging knowledge base, SOPs, and runbooks.
* Contribute to SLA governance by tracking packaging queue metrics, turnaround times, and defect rates.
* Participate in client delivery reviews and contribute packaging status updates and quality metrics.

REQUIRED SKILLS
  

* Advanced MSI packaging — WiX Toolset, InstallShield, AdminStudio (expert-level repackaging and custom authoring)
* MSIX packaging — Package Support Framework, MSIX Packaging Tool, advanced compatibility fix development
* App-V sequencing — virtual application packaging, connection groups, dynamic configuration
* Intune Win32 and SCCM deployment — advanced deployment type configuration, Graph API integration
* PowerShell advanced scripting — detection scripts, pre/post-install automation, batch packaging operations
* Application compatibility — ACT, shims, PSF fixups, UAC/DPI/virtualisation remediation
* Windows internals — deep understanding of registry, file system, services, COM, WMI for packaging analysis
* Log analysis and troubleshooting — MSI verbose logs, AppEnforce.log, CMTrace, Event Viewer, Procmon

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Experience with AdminStudio's Automated Application Converter for bulk MSI-to-MSIX migration
* Azure DevOps or CI/CD pipeline experience for packaging automation
* Flexera Software Vulnerability Manager or third-party patch management integration
* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) or equivalent

MINIMUM EDUCATION
  
  
Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech/BCA/B.Sc. IT/CS) or MCA from a recognised Indian university. Equivalent senior enterprise packaging experience will be considered.

title: Data Scientist Senior Consultant II
description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

**Job Description**

In this role, you will design and build AI-driven Insight Studio for the Scholar product, transforming large-scale customer conversations into actionable, real-time insights. You will hands-on build and productionize AI systems, integrating LLMs, RAG pipelines, and AI agents into scalable, reliable applications that directly power business decisions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Translate complex business problems into end-to-end AI solutions, leveraging machine learning and Generative AI techniques aligned with product and business goals.
* Design, build, and operate production-grade AI systems for conversational understanding, summarization, classification, and insight generation from large-scale customer interaction data.

Job description:

Cactus Life Sciences is a remote-first organization, and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.

If you are looking for challenging and rewarding work which combines your understanding of medical science and aptitude for writing into one unique job, the **Senior Medical Writer** role is for you. This is an opportunity to grow your career and make a greater impact on the lives around you.

Job responsibilities:

* Taking ownership and responsibility for development (write, review, proofread, and data-check) of high-quality, client-ready scientific, medical, and educational materials like slides, abstracts, posters, MSL/training slide decks, infographics, congress and meetings materials, literature searches and reviews, standard response letters/medical information letters, and HCP engagement content according to client and audience needs with excellent attention to detail.
* Actively involved in reviewing materials developed by scientific writers to ensure strategic alignment and scientific accuracy as needed and providing clear constructive feedback, support, and supervision to writers. Mentor and train scientific writers by sharing best practices and client preferences, thereby contributing to skill development within the team.
Having excellent knowledge of product/account to enable meaningful interactions with clients and authors, including consultancy where necessary. Liaising and building and maintaining strong and long-standing professional relationships with international pharmaceutical clients, healthcare professionals, internal and external stakeholders including authors, reviewers and key opinion leaders across therapeutic areas* - learning to anticipate their needs. This includes educating and advising clients on how to best implement their strategic and tactical plans and proactively provide recommendations to clients on how to improve scientific content and propose new document types/ways to disseminate client date more effectively.
* Effectively and proactively communicate with team members, authors/faculty, clients and vendors.
* Attend workshops/seminars/trainings to hone your skills and contribute to organizational objectives.
* Attending client and other external meetings and supporting senior team members as needed
* Apply your scientific and creative knowledge and work closely with client directors in developing ideas and executing effective medical communications initiatives in the digital space, including publication extenders, creation of infographics, interactive assets, website content, patient narratives, and medical information engagement plans. Also, Supporting with the development of visual content and materials using effective data visualization techniques and approaches. Contributing to innovative “out of the box” solutions for medical writing projects.
* You will be responsible for ensuring all materials follow/comply with client requirements/SOPs, style guides, client templates, client preferences (as applicable), and CACTUS’ internal SOPs. Any updates to either of these items should be made consistently and documents should remain up to date.
* Perform as a document specialist, provide intellectual input across document types, and contribute to making cutting-edge research accessible to specific audiences as appropriate, by maintaining current awareness of developments across therapeutic areas or disciplines.
* Supporting with pitches, both during the preparation phase and the actual pitch.

#LI-Remote

Qualifications and prerequisites:

* Minimum of 3 years of experience in relevant fields of scientific writing.
* PhD/MD (Pharmacology) OR PhD (Life Sciences) OR PharmD OR M.Pharm/M.Sc. with a good understanding of clinical research and medical communication.
* Clear, concise, scientific style of writing, with a high level of attention to detail and excellent language skills.
* Ability to adapt writing style to different materials and target audiences.
* Basic knowledge of biostatistics.
* Literature reviewing and evaluation capabilities.
* Very good working knowledge of MS Office.

Application process:

Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised.

Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. All interactions will be conducted virtually via MS Teams.

**Equal Opportunity**

Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

**Accelerating from Anywhere**

As a remote-first organization, these are essential attributes we look for in all our candidates.

* Taking ownership of your work with minimal supervision, showing strong ability to organize, prioritize and deliver results independently.
* Documenting work that brings everyone on the same page.
* Maturity to choose between synchronous and asynchronous collaboration.
* Effectively collaborating with colleagues across different time zones by setting dedicated hours for collaboration and keeping team members updated through your MS Teams status.

About Us:

At Cactus Life Sciences (cactuslifesciences.com), we believe the future of medical communications lies at the intersection of science, technology, and human connection. Headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, with teams in Switzerland, the United Kingdom, India, and Japan, we help biopharmaceutical organizations redefine scientific exchange—leveraging AI, automation, and innovation while keeping patients at the heart of everything we do.

Our expertise spans medical strategy, scientific content development, and medical education across therapeutic areas and the product lifecycle. By blending scientific rigor, agile operational models, and future-ready technologies, we partner with medical affairs teams to catalyse their transformation, adapt to a changing landscape, and drive meaningful outcomes for healthcare communities worldwide.

**About the Role:**

We have transitioned from a traditional, reactive WFM department into a proactive, AI-powered **Resource Orchestration Center (ROC)** organization. Operating as the "Enterprise Brain" of our 1,000-agent, 24/7 global travel operation, we rely on an advanced technology stack—including Genesys Cloud, Snowflake data lakes, ThoughtSpot, and AI-driven analytics—to automate administrative tasks and empower our human talent. We don't just report on what happened; we engineer outcomes to guarantee our elite service level agreements (SLAs) for our travelers and corporate clients.

As a **Service Command Analyst**, you are the tactical controller of our live global travel operations. You will step away from traditional, manual processes and spreadsheet updates. Instead, you will operate in a dynamic, *exception-based* environment. Leveraging real-time, AI-generated alerts and dashboards, you will identify risks before they impact the traveler and execute pre-approved, rapid-response levers to protect the business.

To allow for maximum flexibility and impact, you will not be siloed into a single channel (e.g., "just voice" or "just chat"). Instead, you will act as a **Portfolio Owner** during your shift, managing the holistic health of adaptable business tiers (such as Core, Designated, Dedicated, and Specialty Travel Desks) and adjusting to operational needs as they evolve in the fast-paced travel industry.

**What You'll Do:**

### **Exception-Based Execution & SLA Recovery**

* Monitor automated alerts generated by our Service Intelligence infrastructure indicating SLA risks, volume spikes, or AHT anomalies driven by global travel events.
* Autonomously execute flexible operational levers (e.g., skill blending, channel pivoting, schedule adjustments, or micro-shift overtime) to maintain target SLAs.
* Pivot agents seamlessly between various queues and assignments based on real-time global thresholds and shifting business travel priorities.

### **Portfolio & Queue Ownership**

* Act as the primary operational controller for your assigned portfolios during your regional shift, adapting to volume trends across multiple business lines.
* Ensure highly effective "follow-the-sun" handoffs to your international counterparts to guarantee seamless 24/7 global continuity.

### **Incident & Disruption Management**

* Serve as the tip of the spear during travel and business disruptions (system outages, global flight groundings, weather impacts, natural disasters).
* Command the incident response protocols, issue executive notifications, and dynamically reallocate global staffing resources to mitigate impact on travelers.

### **Strategic Cross-Training & Collaboration**

* Participate in the ROC rotation program, cross-training in forecasting, capacity planning, and basic data intelligence (ThoughtSpot/AI Prompting) to enhance your versatility and eliminate single points of failure.
* Collaborate closely with the Service Intelligence Engineer, BI & Automation Analyst, and Service Excellence Lead to identify repetitive tasks that can be automated out of the Command Center.

**What We're Looking For:**

* **Experience:** 2+ years of progressive experience in Workforce Management, Real-Time Operations, or an Operational Command Center environment. (Experience in the travel industry is a plus and highly preferred).
* **Technical Proficiency:** Deep understanding of modern omnichannel routing platforms; **Genesys Cloud** experience is highly preferred.
* **Data Literacy:** Comfort operating in a modern data ecosystem. Familiarity with navigating data visualization tools (e.g., **ThoughtSpot**, Power BI, Tableau) powered by central data lakes (**Snowflake**).
* **Analytical Agility:** Strong systems-thinking ability. You must be able to digest AI-driven recommendations and quickly decide on the optimal operational lever to pull under pressure, adjusting to new scenarios as they arise.
* **Communication:** Elite communication and interpersonal skills. You will be drafting executive summaries and coordinating rapid responses across multiple global departments.

**Mott MacDonald** is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.

As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.

Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be **brilliant**.

**Job profile-**

We are looking for an experienced **Product Manager** to shape the next generation of our time-series data capability.

Across major infrastructure projects, large volumes of sensor, monitoring and operational data are generated over time. Our Timeseries product enables project teams to bring this information together, connect it with other project data, understand trends and changes, and build data-driven applications and services around it.

You will join our digital product and engineering organisation in India and work with colleagues and project teams around the world.

**Role description**

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a product at an important point in its evolution. We have an established legacy platform supporting real projects and customer use cases, alongside a new cloud-based Timeseries product that we are developing for the future.

Your role will be to understand how our customers and project teams use time-series data today, identify their most important needs, and translate those into a clear product strategy and roadmap for the new platform. Your job will not be to recreate the legacy system feature for feature. You will work with customers, project teams, engineers, architects and other Product Managers to determine:

* what should become part of the core Timeseries product;

* what should be redesigned or simplified;

* what should be enabled through APIs, events and integrations;

* how existing projects can safely transition to the new platform;

* and which legacy capabilities can ultimately be retired.

You will be comfortable working in a technically complex environment while keeping the product focused on user needs, reusable capabilities and measurable outcomes.

**Job Responsibilities** **-**

* Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for our Timeseries product.

* Understand how customers and project teams use time-series, sensor and operational data, and identify the problems that are most valuable for us to solve.

* Lead product discovery with users, project teams, engineers and subject-matter experts, translating their needs into clear product outcomes and priorities.

* Define MVPs and make deliberate decisions about what belongs in the core product and what does not.

* Work closely with the engineering team to maintain a clear, prioritised and delivery-ready product backlog, ensuring upcoming work is understood and aligned to product outcomes.

* Play an active role in the team's agile delivery rhythm, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives, maintaining clarity on priorities, outcomes and learning.

* Shape the product capabilities for ingesting, managing, finding, visualising and responding to time-series data, including ingestion, search and alarming.

* Define how Timeseries works with APIs, events and other applications so that specialist project needs don't create unnecessary complexity within the core product.

* Lead the product strategy for transitioning existing projects from our legacy platform, identifying what should be replaced, redesigned, supported differently or retired, and developing a repeatable migration approach.

* Improve onboarding and self-service so project teams can adopt and configure Timeseries without relying on specialist platform knowledge.

* Work closely with engineering, architecture, design and other product teams to turn product direction into delivered customer outcomes.

* Define meaningful measures of product adoption, customer value and migration progress.

* Communicate product direction, priorities, decisions and progress clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Candidate Specification**

We are looking for an experienced Product Manager who enjoys solving complex product problems and is comfortable working with technical products.

You may currently be working with a data platform, IoT product, analytics platform, developer platform, enterprise SaaS product or another technically complex B2B product.

You do not need to be a software engineer or database specialist. However, you should be technically curious and able to work confidently with engineers and architects, understand the implications of different approaches, and turn technical complexity into clear product decisions.

Most importantly, you will bring strong product judgement. You will be comfortable deciding not only what we should build, but also what we should not build.

Your experience is likely to include several of the following:

* Product strategy, discovery and roadmap ownership.

* B2B, enterprise, platform or data product management.

* Understanding customer and user problems through research and discovery.

* Translating complex needs into product outcomes rather than simply collecting feature requests.

* Defining MVPs and making evidence-based prioritisation and scope decisions.

* Working closely with engineering, architecture and design teams.

* APIs, integrations, data pipelines or other technically complex product capabilities.

* Cloud-based software products.

* Managing products with multiple customer or project use cases.

* Communicating complex product decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Experience leading or contributing to a legacy platform replacement, customer migration, data-platform migration or major product transformation would be particularly valuable.

**Qualifications Preferred** **-**

Experience in some of the following areas would be beneficial, but is not essential:

* time-series databases or time-series data products;

* IoT, sensors, telemetry or operational data;

* Microsoft Azure or other major cloud platforms;

* APIs and SDKs;

* event-driven systems;

* data ingestion and data pipelines;

* data visualisation and analytics;

* alerting or alarming products;

* geospatial or GIS products;

* multi-tenant SaaS or platform products.

We are more interested in finding an excellent Product Manager who is comfortable working with technical products, than somebody who already knows our particular technology stack.

**Further details-**

This role offers the opportunity to shape a product while it is being transformed rather than inheriting one where all the major product decisions have already been made.

You will help us take the best of an established capability, simplify areas that have become complex over time, and establish a modern Timeseries product that can support projects at scale.

You'll have the opportunity to work with real infrastructure use cases and diverse project teams, and to influence how sensor and operational data are used across our digital products in the future.

The successful candidate will ultimately help us answer three important questions:

* What should our Timeseries product become?

* How do we make it simple and valuable for projects to adopt?

* How do we successfully move from the platform we have today to the product we want for the future?

**Flexible working**
  
At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.

  

**Our benefits package is designed to enhance your experience:**

* Agile working
* Critical illness and compassionate leave
* Paternity Leave
* Group term life insurance, and Group medical insurance coverage
* Career mobility options
* Short and Long-term global employment opportunities
* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing
  

**Employment Compliance Requirement**

As part of our global compliance requirements, all candidates must hold a valid Right to Work (RTW) document in India, which will be verified during the recruitment process.
  
**Acceptable documents include a Passport, Voter ID, or Birth Certificate.**
  
By applying, you **confirm** that you can provide valid documentation if and when required.

Gartner Consulting partners with clients to solve their most critical business and technology challenges through collaborative problem solving, and increasingly delivers production-grade solutions alongside its advisory work. We are looking for a hands-on Power Platform & Copilot Solutions Architect to own the architecture and delivery of Microsoft Power Platform and Copilot solutions – both internal assets used by Gartner consulting associates and client-facing solutions deployed in client environments.

This is an all-rounder role: you will articulate solution value to clients, design and build the architecture yourself, lead delivery in client engagements, and guide Power Platform engineers to deliver. You will enhance existing Gartner solutions and build new ones.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

**Client Engagement & Solutioning**

  

* Work with clients and Gartner consultants to understand business problems and translate them into clear, practical solution designs.

* Communicate solution value to business and technical stakeholders; support pre-sales through demos, solution approaches, effort estimates and proposal inputs.

Lead discovery workshops and convert outcomes into requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.  

  

**Architecture & Hands-on Build**

  

* Architect and build solutions using Model-driven and Canvas Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, SharePoint and Power BI.

* Design and build Copilot Studio agents (generative orchestration, topics, tools, knowledge/RAG, autonomous triggers, multi-agent patterns) and Microsoft 365 Copilot declarative agents.

* Deliver integrations using REST/OData APIs, custom and HTTP connectors with Microsoft Entra ID authentication, and Azure services; extend with JavaScript and C# plugins where needed.

Understand, maintain and evolve existing Gartner assets, and create reusable components and patterns across engagements.  

  

**Delivery Leadership**

  

* Lead the end-to-end delivery lifecycle in client engagements – planning, estimation, sprint delivery, testing/UAT, deployment, hypercare and handover.

* Guide, review and mentor Power Platform engineers; set design and development standards and conduct solution reviews.

Manage scope, risks and dependencies; provide clear status updates to engagement leaders and client stakeholders.  

  

**Governance, ALM & Platform Administration**

  

* Administer and govern Power Platform via the Power Platform Admin Center – environment strategy, Managed Environments, DLP policies, security roles, capacity and licensing.

* Own ALM: managed/unmanaged solutions, connection references, environment variables and Power Platform Pipelines/Azure DevOps across DEV, QA and Production.

Set up monitoring and adoption tracking using Copilot Studio analytics, Azure Application Insights, and Copilot Studio Kit; embed security and responsible AI practices.  

  

**What You Will Need**

  

**Must Have**

  

* 5–7 years of overall experience, with hands-on Microsoft Power Platform delivery.

* Strong expertise in Power Apps (Model-driven and Canvas), Power Automate, Dataverse (data modelling, security, business rules) and Power BI.

* Hands-on Copilot Studio experience, including generative AI concepts such as LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, knowledge sources and agent evaluation/testing.

* Experience with Power Platform administration, governance, environment management and ALM/deployment pipelines.

* Integration experience with REST APIs, custom connectors, Microsoft Entra ID (app registrations, authentication) and Azure services.

* Experience leading small delivery teams and owning end-to-end delivery of client or enterprise projects.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to bridge business and technology and explain solutions simply to senior audiences.  

  

**Good to Have**

  

* Microsoft certifications such as PL-600, PL-400 or PL-200; Azure AI certifications are a plus.

* Experience with Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Fabric or Databricks.

* Pro-code skills in JavaScript, C# (.NET) or TypeScript for Dataverse plugins and client-side extensions.
* Prior consulting or professional services experience, or exposure to AI strategy and governance solutions.
